supersedes: none. Derived from cptac-tissue-to-patient-v01-20261014 (kidney, registered) with only the cohort paths, clinical-context columns, protein targets (this type's proteomics), relation class and TCGA replication rule changed; every anti-leakage clause, null, pass rule and budget is kept.

release.name: patient-level episode over frozen slide descriptors (H-Optimus-0 slide embedding, CellViT summaries and structure) + the v0.4 evaluation path
release.runner: morpheus_encoder/scripts/run_general_discovery_packet.py --episode cptac_patient --family <f> --proposer all --arm source, with the episode built for cohort='cptac_coad'
release.commit: the registration commit that adds run_cptac_episode and this status
release.evidence_note: Deep learning enters only as frozen measurement views (H-Optimus-0 slide embedding, CellViT nuclei); no model is trained on any response or outcome.
runner_requirements: the runner passes cohort='cptac_coad' to cptac_patient_episode (one argument; the kidney default is unchanged)
relation 'lin_spline_v01' added to general_discovery.RELATIONS (definition in discovery.relation_note)

discovery.candidate_budget_meaning: frozen candidates per relationship family entering the ledger at 'proposed'
discovery.unit: patient (one tumour slide and one bulk tumour sample per patient)
discovery.outer_split: five stage-stratified patient folds over the 56 slide-mapped CPTAC COAD tumours (cptac_patient_folds: deterministic shuffle with fold_seed, round-robin within stage; patients with unknown stage form one stratum); each fold in turn is D_R (~11 patients), the other four D_P (~45); slide PCA, programme z-statistics and every standardisation are fit on D_P only
discovery.rows: tumours only (no .N normal rows); a patient missing the response, any structure column or any competitor column is dropped and listed in the receipt; nothing is imputed

targets.definition_rule: programme score = mean of per-gene z-scores (z statistics on D_P; gene kept if finite in >= 50% of D_P; >= 3 finite member genes per patient, else missing); never derived from a slide descriptor
targets.rna_programmes: 41 Gavish malignant metaprograms (rna_mp1..rna_mp41, mp_id order) and 50 MSigDB Hallmarks (rna_hm_<NAME>) on log2(transcriptomics__washu + 1), symbols deduplicated
targets.protein_programmes: the same 91 gene sets on this type's proteomics__umich log ratios (CPTAC COAD), canonical isoform per symbol (dedupe_symbols): prot_mp1..prot_mp41, prot_hm_<NAME>

candidate_variables.hoptimus_slide: hos_pc1..hos_pc10: PCA (fit on D_P, columns standardised on D_P) of the 3072-d H-Optimus-0 slide embedding (mean and sd over QC-passed tiles of the 1536-d tile embedding, embeddings.h5 hoptimus_meanstd)
candidate_variables.cellvit_summary: cv_count_density_per_mm2, cv_mean_nuclear_area_um2, cv_class_fraction_<5 PanNuke classes> (cellvit_summary.parquet from wsi_slide_descriptors.py; area/density rescaled to true um by the loader, as TCGA-KIRC)
candidate_variables.cellvit_structure: cvs_*: nuclear area mean/sd, circularity, elongation (all and per abundant class), kNN (k=6) median distance, class-to-class neighbour fractions, log2 assortativity, immune intratumoral / aggregate / tumour-immune contact fractions, 256-um tile composition entropy, per-class fraction sd, density cv, tissue area (summarize_cell_structure on CellViT cells.json, level-0 mpp)
candidate_variables.clinical_context: only for the context family: age, sex_male, stage, mucinous, mut_APC, mut_TP53, mut_KRAS, mut_PIK3CA, mut_BRAF (generic clinical rule: sex only when both sexes occur, stage/grade only when known for >= 50% of patients; absent here: grade (known for 0%))

primary: clinical: age, sex_male, stage, mucinous (fraction known among slide-mapped patients: age 98%, sex_male 100%, stage 100%, mucinous 100%)
deconvolution: ESTIMATE StromalScore/ImmuneScore/ESTIMATEScore/TumorPurity, CIBERSORT 22 cell fractions, xCell ImmuneScore/StromaScore/MicroenvironmentScore
depth_proxy: detected genes and log total expression of the washu table (the deposited table is normalised; raw read depth is not available)
competitor_set.informational: clinical + depth_proxy (+ slide_technical) only (no deconvolution) -- reported beside the primary for every row and used for the positive controls, because the RNA-derived immune and stromal estimates are expected to absorb much of what composition carries
competitor_set.rule: the simpler model is fit on D_P and frozen; gain = R2(simpler + candidate feature, D_R) - R2(simpler, D_R); ridge on competitor columns standardised on D_P with alpha chosen by patient-grouped inner CV on D_P over VALIDATION_ALPHA_GRID (includes the zero model); the full model chosen the same way, independently
competitor_set.exclusion_clause: the competitor never contains the response; deconvolution estimates are computed from the same bulk RNA as rna_programmes but are not a function of any single programme; receipts record the baseline column names
competitor_set.centring_rule: patient is the unit: every column is standardised across D_P patients; no within-patient centring (one row per patient)
competitor_set.column_rule: as kidney (cptac_patient_episode): a competitor or candidate column missing for > 10% of patients is dropped and listed; then rows missing any kept column are dropped and listed; nothing is imputed

null_suite.patient_perm: permutation of the response across D_R patients
null_suite.descriptor_perm_within_stage: permutation of whole slide-descriptor rows among D_R patients of the same stage (keeps response, competitor and the stage-structure association)
null_suite.interaction_break: for |S| >= 2, within-stage permutation of one constituent across D_R patients

advance_rule.passing_fold: held-out full-model R2 > 0 and patient-bootstrap gain CI lower bound > 0 (the v0.4 runner's validated rule)
advance_rule.proposed: per family: top 50 hypotheses by mean held-out gain over passing folds
advance_rule.internal: passing in >= 3 of 5 folds, all applicable structured nulls p <= 0.05 in those folds, mean gain >= 0.01, BH q <= 0.10 within family; recurrence counts passing folds only
advance_rule.pooled_out_of_fold: informational, pre-declared: one out-of-fold prediction per patient (each from its own fold's frozen fit) for each frozen candidate; gain with a 110-patient bootstrap CI. Reported beside the fold rule; it changes no stage
advance_rule.external: TCGA-COAD (independent cohort, same modalities: H&E diagnostic slide + bulk RNA), for every internal hypothesis and every proposed hypothesis with >= 2 passing folds: slide PCs = the TCGA H-Optimus-0 slide embeddings standardised within TCGA and projected on the PCA loadings fitted on all CPTAC patients of this type (slide_pca_loadings.npz written by wsi_slide_descriptors.py finalize; embeddings.h5 hoptimus_pcs_discovery_basis); every constituent column z-scored within its own cohort; the frozen feature computed in each cohort; the association is the Spearman correlation of the feature with the target programme after both are residualised on the competitor columns available in both cohorts (age, sex_male, stage, rna_detected_genes, rna_log_total); replicated = same sign as in CPTAC (all patients, same residualisation) and two-sided permutation p <= 0.05 (9,999 permutations); patients without the needed slide columns are left out and n is reported; BH across the replication table is reported beside p. TCGA slides are processed in sha256(patient id) order after the patients with RNA, so the TCGA patients embedded at replication time are a random subset; the replication uses every TCGA patient with RNA and a slide descriptor at the time it is run, and that n is fixed in the replication record before any association is computed. Protein-family hypotheses have no TCGA protein and are replicated against the RNA programme of the same gene set ('cross-modality replication'). Context hypotheses that need a column TCGA lacks (grade, driver mutations) are reported as not assessable. Label: 'external replication (same modalities, independent cohort)'.
advance_rule.orthogonal: a structure->RNA-programme candidate is re-scored against the protein analogue of the same programme (same sign, permutation p <= 0.05), and vice versa
advance_rule.actionable: survival only for replicated hypotheses: survival spec written and hashed (with the ledger hash) before any outcome is read; CPTAC COAD OS, TCGA-COAD OS/PFS/DSS; Cox on tertiles with the clinical covariates available in both cohorts; BH across the spec
advance_rule.explanation_level: every internal candidate is decomposed (decompose_explanation): A simple / B additive / C non-additive / D context-dependent; E/F only from external evidence flags; nothing is dropped for being Level A

power.per_fold: as kidney: a single feature needs a partial correlation of roughly 0.4 with the residual for a 95% interval above zero on one held-out fold
power.pooled: about 0.27 partial correlation on 56 out-of-fold patients
power.reading: the fold rule detects only strong slide->programme relations; the pooled readout is the sensitive one and is reported for every frozen candidate

proposers.enumeration: singles and low-order products over the family's candidate views
proposers.residual_generator: same as v0.4 with the graph branch off (no spatial graph at patient level)
proposers.rule: one shared per-target budget, ranked jointly by patient-grouped CV proposal gain on D_P; every hypothesis records its proposer

structure_x_clinical_context_to_programm.requirement: every hypothesis carries at least one slide-structure variable and at least one clinical_context variable (age, sex_male, stage, mucinous, mut_APC, mut_TP53, mut_KRAS, mut_PIK3CA, mut_BRAF); additive main effects of the context are in the competitor

tissue_to_patient_outcome.status: deferred: runs only after the three families above are frozen and hashed, with the survival spec written and hashed first (survival_spec_template)

survival_spec_template.purpose: predeclared structure->outcome stage for candidates frozen by this campaign; written with dbench.translational.write_survival_spec (sha256) AFTER the internal freeze and BEFORE any outcome is loaded; run with run_predeclared_survival(spec, load_cptac_survival_cohort)
survival_spec_template.frozen_candidates_sha256: filled at freeze: canonical_hash of the list of internal candidates (candidate_hash, family, target, variable names, feature form)
survival_spec_template.candidates_entering: every hypothesis replicated in TCGA-COAD under advance_rule.external
survival_spec_template.feature: the frozen candidate feature computed on all 56 patients with transforms fitted on all 56 patients (no outcome is used by any transform)
survival_spec_template.model: fit_cox_tertiles: Cox PH (Efron ties), covariates alone vs covariates + feature tertile dummies (low = reference); LR test 2 df; Harrell C increment with 200-resample bootstrap
survival_spec_template.multiplicity: BH across every (candidate, cohort, endpoint) row of this spec
survival_spec_template.controls: stage hazard ratios (where stage exists) are reported as the technical positive control; a candidate result is read only if they behave as expected
survival_spec_template.power: event counts are not read before registration (no outcome column has been opened for this type); they are computed and stated when the survival spec is hashed

discovery.relation_note: lin_spline_v01 (patient-level relation class; Agent P's v0.1 finding: the random-feature relation is overparameterised at ~88 proposal patients, median 5-seed gain spread 0.48): one ridge over [comparison | hypothesis block] with two penalties chosen jointly by patient-grouped 5-fold inner CV on D_P (comparison grid 1e2..1e6 or the zero model, block grid 1..1e4 or the zero model, as v06). Hypothesis block: k = 1 -> the linear term plus a natural cubic spline basis with 3 degrees of freedom (boundary knots at the D_P minimum/maximum, interior knots at the D_P terciles, basis fitted on D_P only); k >= 2 -> the linear constituents plus their pairwise products (no random features, no spline). Deterministic: no seed enters the fit. Receipts record both penalties, gain_linear and gain_nonlinear_beyond_linear (k = 1, the spline part) or gain_linear_additive (k >= 2) with patient-bootstrap CIs, and the shape label. A block chosen at the zero model predicts as the comparison model (gain, CI and nulls exactly 0 / 1). The comparison model is unchanged from kidney v0.1. RUNNER: not yet in general_discovery.RELATIONS (owner of that file adds it before registration); until then this draft cannot run.

translation.cptac: patient-level structure -> programme/protein; survival only through the hashed spec
forbidden: outcome-guided selection of descriptors, targets, folds or competitor columns
fitting any model to OS/PFS before the survival spec is hashed
calling a held-out CPTAC fold an external replication

positive_controls.purpose: separate a technical failure from a real absence; informational, nothing is admitted or excluded because of them

controls.name: inflammatory_fraction_to_immune_programmes
controls.expected: passes (held-out R2 > 0, CI > 0) in >= 3 folds under the informational competitor (clinical + depth); under the primary competitor it may be absorbed by the deconvolution estimates, which is itself the reading

positive_controls.note: CellViT columns are required by the controls; under the box's current GPU load CellViT is the slow block (see runs/development/pancancer_tissue_to_patient/STATUS.md)
